title: A .parent step after a key or a subscript is the struct holding that field
description: hdr.parent is the root (count 9); hdr.n.parent is hdr, though n is a scalar; hdr.items[0].parent is hdr, the struct holding the array field; in an element, v.parent.parent climbs one above the element, to hdr; and above the root the step is Null, as root.parent is.
